name: Opening Data 2
definition: List of elements which specify the opening of a non deliverable trade.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Date at which the trading parties execute a treasury trade.

NotificationIdentification.name: Notification Identification
NotificationIdentification.definition: Refers to the identification of a notification assigned by the trading side.

CommonReference.name: Common Reference
CommonReference.definition: Reference common to the parties of a trade.

RelatedReference.name: Related Reference
RelatedReference.definition: Refers to the identification of a previous event in the life of a non deliverable forward trade.

AmendOrCancelReason.name: Amend Or Cancel Reason
AmendOrCancelReason.definition: Describes the reason for the cancellation or the amendment.

TradeAmounts.name: Trade Amounts
TradeAmounts.definition: Specifies the amounts of the non deliverable trade which is reported.

AgreedRate.name: Agreed Rate
AgreedRate.definition: Exchange rate between two currencies. The rate is agreed by the trading parties during the negotiation process.

ValuationConditions.name: Valuation Conditions
ValuationConditions.definition: Set of parameters used to calculate the valuation rate to be applied to a non-deliverable agreement.
